answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that unlocks only after its work earns endorsements from established peers, so reputation compounds like a ripple spreading outward: one verified job earns one backer, whose backing earns more. A falcon-fast flood of fresh sock puppets gains nothing, because new identities start bond-locked and unendorsed, and each fake must fund its own bond and wait out the same slow spiral of earned trust, making the cost of a thousand fakes a thousand times the cost of one.
